sections.Profile:
The "Satellite" pinball machine, produced by C.E.A. Electronics Corporation in 1978, is a solid-state, four-player game featuring two flippers, two pop bumpers, two slingshots, seven standup targets, two star rollovers, a spinning target, a kick-out hole, and a messenger ball. The artwork and playfield design are inspired by Gottlieb's 1977 "Jet Spin" and "Super Spin" machines. The art was created by Michele Martinelli.
